# search.concordance { #polars_corpus.search.concordance }

```python
search.concordance(search_results, expr, window=None, chunk_tag=None)
```

Generate a concordance from search results (functional interface).

This function provides a functional interface to SearchResults.concordance().
It's equivalent to calling search_results.concordance(expr, window, chunk_tag).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default    |
|----------------|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| search_results | SearchResults  | The search results to generate concordance from.                                                                                                                                                   | _required_ |
| expr           | IntoExprColumn | Column name or Polars expression for concordance display.                                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| window         | int            | Number of tokens to include on both left and right sides of each match. If None, returns matches with no context (equivalent to window=0). When chunk_tag is specified, this parameter is ignored. | `None`     |
| chunk_tag      | str            | Column name defining chunk boundaries for context extraction. When specified, context extends to chunk boundaries marked by "B" (begin) and "I" (inside) tags, ignoring the window parameter.      | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                 |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------|
|        | pl.DataFrame | KWIC concordance DataFrame. |

## See Also {.doc-section .doc-section-see-also}

SearchResults.concordance : Method interface for the same functionality.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> conc = concordance(results, "token", window=5)
>>> conc = concordance(results, "token", chunk_tag="sentence_tags")
```
